entry.title: I Tried AlphaStar's PvT Build — Can a Human Make It Work?

media:group.media:title: I Tried AlphaStar's PvT Build — Can a Human Make It Work?
media:group.media:description:
Can I make AlphaStar's PvT style work without AlphaStar's micro?
We look at the original idea, then I try my own eight-worker adaptation: early Adept and Oracle pressure, a fast third, and Phoenix support for the ground army. The supply block is very human. So are the adjustments when the Terran changes the plan.
It works out in this replay, but I don't think this style feels as strong on the eight-worker patch as it did with twelve workers. This is one replay example, and I'm still experimenting with it.
We already tried the PvP idea. Watch that next: https://youtu.be/Jkyjd8R7Qfs
Would you keep the Phoenix style, or change the follow-up? Let me know in the comments.

media:group.media:title: PvZ: Dark Templar Into Skytoss
media:group.media:description:
Can Dark Templar buy you the time to get into Skytoss?
The idea is to use DTs to protect the third while two Void Rays pick off Overseers. If Zerg's push has no anti-air, meet it out on the map. That gives the Void Rays time to remove detection before the army reaches your Nexus.
From there, I go into a Mothership, Carriers and Archons. The tradeoff is how much tech you're buying with very few units on the map. If Zerg drones hard and gets fast Lair tech, this opening gets a lot less comfortable. I go through the scouting, the defenses and the decisions in this replay.
If this helps, please like and subscribe. Leave any questions about the build or other follow-ups in the comments.

entry.title: PvZ Carrier Rush: Can Zerg Stop It?

media:group.media:title: PvZ Carrier Rush: Can Zerg Stop It?
media:group.media:description:
I'm rushing Carriers, but I can't give Zerg a free game.
This StarCraft II PvZ build uses early Adept and Oracle pressure to buy time for a Fleet Beacon and Carriers. I walk through the opening, the decision to attack with the first two Carriers, and the Void Ray support for the Corruptor switch.
It gets messy. An accidental Phoenix turns into a useful scout, Zerglings get through my natural, and the final fight comes down to more than just having Carriers. Watch for the Time Warp and Prismatic Alignment.
Carrier enjoyer, or absolutely not? Tell me what you'd change, and leave your build questions below.
Watch next — the Blink Stalker route: PvZ Fast Mothership? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aSGYCTVBjqY
